purpose: NPB+ Sprint SpeedをMLB Statcast Sprint Speed/T90モデルへ直接接続できるだけの同一選手overlapがあるかを、2026 NPB+ snapshotと保存済みMLB bridge履歴で確認する。

sources.mlb_running_split_check: Baseball Savant 2024 Running Splits artifact from workflow run 31292752194

naming.official_metric_name: Sprint Speed / スプリントスピード
naming.note: DB storage name remains for compatibility; appraisal evidence canonical name is npb_plus_sprint_speed_kmh.

overlaps.interpretation: Only temporally usable direct overlap. The same player differs by ~3.15 km/h after raw unit conversion across systems/years, so numeric metric equivalence cannot be assumed. The two-year gap also prevents attributing the difference solely to metric definition.

decision: One temporally usable overlap is insufficient to identify an NPB+ Sprint Speed -> T90 regression.
Do not copy MLB Sprint Speed coefficients into the NPB+ model by ft/s<->km/h unit conversion.
Do not assign an NPB+ numeric MAE floor from the MLB LOYO error until an NPB bridge is calibrated.
Retain the existing NPB v3 mapping only as an evaluation-only provisional bridge, never as a validated production T90 model.
The next valid calibration gate is more same-player near-season overlap or direct NPB T90/trajectory labels; broad player-by-player web research is not required for current scope.
